ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Credit_Debit_Note' , OR(ISNEW(),ISCHANGED(Credit_Debit_note_number__c)), AND(!ISBLANK(Credit_Debit_note_number__c),OR( LEN( Credit_Debit_note_number__c) <= 11 , LEN( Credit_Debit_note_number__c) = 13, LEN( Credit_Debit_note_number__c) = 14, LEN( Credit_Debit_note_number__c) >= 16 ) ))
